steps: Title globe, tapped Hormuz Convoy pin
Scrolled down to dossier, Take office as United States
Picked Hit the IRGC navy now (YOUR PICK stamp), Execute
Mostly accepted cabinet picks and pressed Execute for 12 months
Reached verdict, achievements, moments, how seen, numbers, truth, ranking, share card
scenarios.notes: Started within about 30 s and the first big moment came at the first Execute. After that I mostly pressed Execute on defaults, so the huge moves faded.

steps: Reached Ranking and the share card preview
scenarios.notes: Share card preview is good looking, but it says MISSION FAILED, D and 0 stars, not something I would post. Share result tap showed no visible reaction in the driver.

friction.where: Title screen, after tapping a pin
friction.expected: A dossier or start panel right there
friction.happened: The globe zoomed but the dossier was far below the fold, I had to scroll past the seed box; the dossier panel overlaps the seed box in the scroll

friction.expected: Know what Hormuz, Bab al-Mandab, Quarantine, Scarborough are
friction.happened: Names of flashpoints and Play this seed with a code are unexplained
IRGC, midterms, Isfahan, uranium, approval 56%+, UAE relations, Muscat are unexplained; I read none of it
Three cards, plus advisor suggestions, plus coachmarks (Step 1 of 3); a lot to read, though cards with images and Hurts labels helped

friction.where: Desk, tapping a card by text
friction.happened: act text on the card title returned ok false; had to tap by coordinates
Dense: tension, relations, approval bars, mission, score paragraph, chronicle strip, chips. Mostly text.
Coordinate sanctions and talks, ceasefire framework, enrichment: no help in place
Newspaper says Month 6 of 12 while HUD says month 7
Advisors pre-add orders (spy, sabotage) that I never chose, one of which failed and showed up as a 'went badly' moment; Execute on default is so easy I stopped choosing
MISSION FAILED, D, 0 stars, but title Master Diplomat and 663/1000 and text 'You made your nation respected'. Failed by 1 point (Israel 60 vs 61), felt unfair.
Deals signed 0 though I signed India's offer; Covert ops text overflows 0 ok, 2 caught
Table clipped at right edge (SEA column cut)
Final month square is black, legend says black is the fall, but I did not fall

bugs.title: Month number mismatch between newspaper and HUD
Deals signed counter 0 after signing India's offer
Verdict contradicts itself
bugs.actual: Mission failed D 0 stars with Master Diplomat praise text

bugs.title: Ranking record table clipped on tablet
Lowercase 'trump' in headline chip
bugs.actual: Sabotage Iran failed; trump decides: Abstain

suggestions.what: Open the dossier as a bottom sheet right on the globe after tapping a pin, with one big Play button
Do not pre-add advisor orders; make the one big move the default and ask for a second
Share card should celebrate something (best moment, biggest swing) even when mission failed, and show a clear Share action feedback
Tap-to-explain on terms like IRGC, sanctions, enrichment

delight: Jet strike scene after Send in special forces (shots/noah-tablet/011-m2r.png)
YOUR PICK stamp on a card
The fog lifts: your estimate crossed out vs actual (shots/noah-tablet/041-r6.png)
Approval graph Doubted in December, thanked by October

fun.reason: Cool art and the first strike felt big, but later months were just Execute.

clarity.reason: Cards are clear, jargon and dense result cards are not.

visual.reason: Scenes, globe, badges look like a real game.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Stamps, badges, grade, share card; but month loop is slow and text heavy.

agency.reason: Never blocked, but defaults did the choosing and a 1 point miss felt unexplained.

realism.reason: Real names, real world comparison at the end was a nice learn.

replay.reason: Replay same opening and seed code are good; failing by 1 makes me want to retry.

recommend.reason: I would show friends the globe and badges, not the result card of a failed D.

verbatim: The globe and the jet scene are sick. But why did it say Master Diplomat and also Failed? And I only lost by one point. I would send the badges, not the D.
